record.paper_title: Twenty Open Questions in Supersymmetric Particle Physics
record.original_question: Heterotic string theory predicts gauge and gravitational coupling unification at a string scale of order 5 × 10^17 GeV, whereas MSSM gauge couplings appear to unify near 2 × 10^16 GeV. How can these two ends meet in realistic string-derived supersymmetric models, and which path to unification—string GUTs, non-standard affine levels or hypercharge normalization, heavy string thresholds, light supersymmetry thresholds, intermediate gauge structure, extra exotic matter, or non-perturbative string effects—is self-consistent and phenomenologically viable?

evidence.quote: Question #20 Making ends meet: How can we understand gauge coupling unification from string theory?
Mstring ≈ 5 × 10^17 GeV — a factor of 20 discrepancy relative to the MSSM prediction!

This is the problem of gauge coupling unification in string theory. Essentially, given the high-energy predictions of string theory and our low-energy experimental couplings, we face the classic question: how can we make the two ends meet?
Thus, we are faced with one over-riding question: Which solution(s) to the problem — i.e., which ‘path to unification’ — does string theory actually take?

The question, then, is to determine which of the above potential solutions to the string unification problem are self-consistent in string theory, and can be realized in actual realistic string models.

artifact.category_tag: String phenomenology and gauge coupling unification
artifact.status_search_result: The discrepancy between the heterotic string unification scale (~5×10^17 GeV) and the MSSM gauge-coupling unification scale (~2×10^16 GeV) remains an actively studied open problem in string phenomenology. Numerous partial resolutions have been proposed and explored (string GUTs from free-fermionic and orbifold constructions, higher Kac–Moody levels, heavy/light threshold corrections, intermediate gauge structures, exotic matter, strong-coupling/M-theory effects, magnetized compactifications), but no single mechanism has been established as the unique, fully realistic resolution within an explicit string-derived model.

status_evidence.title: Gauge Coupling Unification in Heterotic String Models with Gauge Mediated SUSY Breaking
status_evidence.snippet: Discusses persistent discrepancy between string unification scale ~5×10^17 GeV and MSSM unification scale ~2×10^16 GeV and proposes gauge-mediation-based reconciliation.
status_evidence.claim: The mismatch is still treated as an open problem requiring new model-building input.

status_evidence.title: Gauge coupling unification in SO(32) heterotic string theory with magnetic fluxes
status_evidence.snippet: Recent attempts use magnetized compactifications to address the heterotic-vs-MSSM unification scale mismatch.
status_evidence.claim: Active recent work indicates the problem is not definitively solved.

status_evidence.title: U(1)' coupling constant at low energies from heterotic orbifolds
status_evidence.snippet: Explores intermediate gauge structure from heterotic orbifolds, relevant to unification-scale reconciliation.
status_evidence.claim: Multiple competing reconciliation mechanisms continue to be studied.
